headline: Aurum PropTech submits statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32
hook: Routine compliance filing from Aurum PropTech
summary: Aurum PropTech Limited has submitted its statement of deviation or variation to the stock exchange pursuant to Regulation 32 of SEBI listing regulations. This disclosure details any divergence between the actual utilization of funds raised and the objects stated in the issue document. Such procedural filings are standard corporate governance requirements for listed companies. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review how capital is being deployed.
why_it_matters: Confirms fund utilization status for company shareholders.

headline: Aurum PropTech reports Q2 FY27 profit alongside Housing.com deal completion
summary: Aurum PropTech has posted its Q2 FY27 financial results, showing a continued profit streak despite a sequential slide in earnings. The quarter's performance coincides with the successful closure of the Housing.com strategic transaction. For Indian retail investors, the integration of Housing.com and ongoing profitability indicate shifting operational dynamics within the listed proptech space.
whats_next: Next quarterly earnings filing in Q3 FY27
why_it_matters: Proptech earnings and deal execution impact stock sentiment.
winners_losers: Aurum holders watch deal integration / Near-term profit slide weighs

headline: Aurum PropTech allots 5.1 million warrants to promoter
hook: Promoter increases stake via warrant allotment
summary: Aurum PropTech Limited has allotted 5,100,000 fully convertible warrants to its promoter, Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited. The allotment was approved via a circular resolution on October 13, 2026. This move increases the promoter's potential equity stake in the company upon conversion. Retail investors should note that warrant issues often signal promoter confidence or a need for capital infusion.
why_it_matters: Promoter stake changes can signal long-term confidence in company growth.
